CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.v_feishu_tbl_gamma_v2 AS
WITH parsed_base AS (
    SELECT 
      COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(fields->>'MYear', '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), ''), '0')::INTEGER AS current_year,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(fields->>'MMonth', '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), ''), '0')::INTEGER AS current_month,
      COALESCE(fields->>'AreaName', '') AS f_area,
      COALESCE(fields->>'RegionName', '') AS f_region,
      COALESCE(fields->>'BusinessManager', '') AS f_manager,
      COALESCE(fields->>'IndustryLine', '') AS f_industry,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(fields->>'TargetAmount', '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'), ''), '0')::NUMERIC AS target_amount,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(fields->>'SellInAmount', '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'), ''), '0')::NUMERIC AS billing_amount,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(fields->>'SellInAmount_LastYear', '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'), ''), '0')::NUMERIC AS billing_last_year
    FROM public.feishu_tbl_gamma_v2
)
SELECT 
  current_year AS 年份,
  current_month AS 月份,
  CASE 
    WHEN f_area = '' AND f_region = '' AND f_manager = '' THEN '事业群层级'
    WHEN f_area LIKE '%战区' THEN '区域线'
    WHEN f_area LIKE '%行业部' THEN '行业线'
    ELSE '区域线'
  END AS 线,
  CASE 
    WHEN f_area = '' AND f_region = '' AND f_manager = '' THEN '事业群'
    WHEN f_area <> '' AND f_region = '' AND f_manager = '' THEN '战区'
    WHEN f_area <> '' AND f_region <> '' AND f_manager = '' THEN '片区'
    WHEN f_area <> '' AND f_manager <> '' THEN '客户经理'
    ELSE '未知'
  END AS 层级,
  CASE 
    WHEN f_area = '' AND f_region = '' AND f_manager = '' THEN '商用事业群'
    WHEN f_area <> '' AND f_region = '' AND f_manager = '' THEN f_area
    WHEN f_area <> '' AND f_region <> '' AND f_manager = '' THEN f_region
    WHEN f_area <> '' AND f_manager <> '' THEN f_manager
    ELSE '未知'
  END AS 节点名称,
  CASE 
    WHEN f_area = '' AND f_region = '' AND f_manager = '' THEN '无'
    WHEN f_area <> '' AND f_region = '' AND f_manager = '' THEN '商用事业群'
    WHEN f_area <> '' AND f_region <> '' AND f_manager = '' THEN f_area
    WHEN f_area <> '' AND f_region <> '' AND f_manager <> '' THEN f_region
    WHEN f_area <> '' AND f_region = '' AND f_manager <> '' THEN f_area
    ELSE '无'
  END AS 上级名称,
  CASE 
    WHEN f_industry = '' THEN '总额(未拆分)'
    ELSE f_industry
  END AS 行业线,
  target_amount AS 总任务金额,
  billing_amount AS 年度开单金额,
  billing_last_year AS 去年同期开单,
  CASE WHEN target_amount > 0 THEN ROUND(billing_amount / target_amount * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS 达成率,
  ROUND(target_amount - billing_amount, 2) AS 剩余任务金额
FROM parsed_base;

SELECT 
  年份 AS current_year,
  月份 AS current_month,
  线 AS line_type,
  层级 AS node_level,
  节点名称 AS node_name,
  上级名称 AS parent_node,
  行业线 AS segment_name,
  总任务金额 AS target_amount,
  年度开单金额 AS billing_amount,
  去年同期开单 AS billing_last_year,
  达成率 AS achievement_rate,
  剩余任务金额 AS remaining_target
FROM public.v_feishu_tbl_gamma_v2;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_feishu_tbl_beta AS
SELECT
  id,
  record_id,
  fields->>'状态' AS 审批状态,
  fields->>'编号' AS 编号,
  fields->>'经营主体' AS 集团,
  fields->>'事业群' AS 事业群,
  NULLIF(fields->>'行业部','') AS 行业部,
  NULLIF(fields->>'业务承接角色','') AS 细分业务,
  fields->>'层级级别' AS 层级级别,
  fields->>'任务承接人' AS 负责人,
  fields->>'任务维护人' AS 上级负责人,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'总任务（金额）'),'')::numeric AS 年度目标营收,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'年度开单金额'),'')::numeric AS 年度开单金额,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'总任务达成率'),'')::numeric AS 总任务达成率,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'当前月份任务达成率'),'')::numeric AS 当前月份任务达成率,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'截止当前目标阈值达成率'),'')::numeric AS 截止当前目标阈值达成率,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'本月开单金额'),'')::numeric AS 本月开单金额,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'本月当前目标阈值'),'')::numeric AS 本月当前目标阈值,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'年度阈值/开单差额（万）'),'')::numeric AS 年度阈值开单差额万,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'月度阈值/开单差额（万）'),'')::numeric AS 月度阈值开单差额万,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'总金额转换（以万为单位）'),'')::numeric AS 总金额转换万,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'年度开单金额转换（以万为单位）'),'')::numeric AS 年度开单金额转换万,
  fields->>'链接字段(勿删)' AS 组织路径,
  fields->>'当前年' AS 当前年,
  fields->>'当前月' AS 当前月,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'2601'),'')::numeric AS q1目标,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'2602'),'')::numeric AS q2目标,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'2603'),'')::numeric AS q3目标,
  NULLIF(trim(fields->>'2604'),'')::numeric AS q4目标
FROM feishu_tbl_beta
WHERE fields IS NOT NULL AND fields <> '{}'::jsonb
  AND NULLIF(fields->>'编号','') IS NOT NULL;
